text:
sara: Heads-up — noticed the runtime quickstart's curl snippet 404s and the frontmatter missing an owner. link: https://internal.docs/runtime/quickstart
jon: ah yeah saw that earlier in staging, didn't file a bug. can you paste the failing curl?
sara: here — `curl -sS https://cdn.internal/docs/runtime/quickstart/samples/setup.sh | bash` returns 404; also the frontmatter has no `owner:` so scans skip it.
link-scan-bot: Scan result: docs/runtime/quickstart.md - missing owner metadata; external asset 404 at /samples/setup.sh (last seen 2025-02-11).
alexa: i can add the owner entry and do a tiny frontmatter fix, but someone needs to decide where to rehost the sample script.
mike: @alexa i can rehost the script on the docs-assets bucket and set a shortlink. ping me the PR and i'll add the object.
jon: if alexa is doing the doc edit i can open a PR that points the snippet at the new shortlink. want me to include a test in the samples smoke CI job to curl the URL?
alexa: yes please — include a quick `curl -f` check in `.github/workflows/doc-smoke.yml` so this doesn't regress. keep it tiny.
sara: ideal — owner: @alexa in frontmatter, pr: jon, host: mike, ci: jon add smoke. can we do this as a fast patch today?
jon: working on branch `docs/quickstart-fix-1791010101`. gonna push a small frontmatter change + CI step, leave the snippet target as placeholder.
mike: uploaded script to `s3://redwood-docs-assets/runtime/setup-2025-02-11.sh` and created shortlink `/r/s/runtime/setup.sh`. link: https://assets.redwood/s/runtime/setup.sh
john: (typo, meant jon) pushed PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8422 — includes frontmatter owner, CI curl check, and switches sample to the shortlink.
alexa: quick review done, left one nit on spacing in frontmatter. jon can you squash that and i'll merge?
jon: squashed + updated. thanks for the review.
sara: amazing — thanks everyone. marking as done in tracker (KB-4317) :tada:
mike: ran the doc-smoke workflow locally and curl check passed. leaving comment on PR with smoke log.
alexa: merged. tagging owner in the file now. all good to close.
sara: closing thread — appreciate the quick turnaround :+1:
